body:
What

Turn lines such as 2 cups flour, sifted into an amount, a unit and an item.

How
  • A table of about 40 units and their short forms.
  • Words after a comma become a note on the item.
  • A line it can't read goes on the list as it is.
Done When

All 120 sample recipes parse with no line dropped.
name: Ingredient Parser
